retrievalProfile.description: A warm, earthy portrait composition featuring a seated figure on a wooden bench with wide-tracked, heavy-set typography positioned in the upper right quadrant.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a man in casual attire seated on a weathered wooden bench, set against a textured, warm-toned wall. The composition uses a rule-of-thirds approach with the subject on the left and bold, wide-spaced typography on the right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject on the left balanced by heavy typography on the right
Horizontal lines of the bench bisecting the frame
Tonal harmony between the wooden textures and the background wall
Soft, directional lighting creating gentle shadows on the subject's face
coreInvariants: Warm sepia or ochre color cast

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned in the left third of the frame, seated with legs crossed, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The horizontal wooden bench back serves as the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the subject's face, follows his gaze toward the right, and lands on the bold typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper right quadrant is utilized for text placement.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ochre and sienna (background and bench)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a focus on mid-tones and deep shadows to create a vintage, grounded feel.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif or geometric sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Small decorative fleur-de-lis or cross icons used as separators
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used with varying scale and tracking to create hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Small geometric icons flanking the secondary text line

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the small-serif, wide-set masculine feel.
Provides the necessary slab-serif weight and presence.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a blue denim shirt and dark pants sitting on a rustic yellow-wood bench against a textured tan wall, sepia-toned lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, black, uppercase slab-serif text in the upper right corner with wide letter spacing and small decorative cross icons between words.

verificationChecks: Is the text tracking sufficiently wide?
Is the color palette restricted to warm earth tones and navy?
Is the subject placed off-center to the left?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
postGenerationChecks: Verify the horizontal bench line is straight
Ensure the text does not overlap the subject
Check that the sepia tone is consistent across the image
Confirm the typography feels 'heavy' and grounded
recipe.reuseFormula: Seated portrait + Rule of Thirds + Wide-tracked Slab Serif + Earthy Sepia Palette = Rustic Americana Aesthetic
